query: Thermoplastic polyurethane hydrolysis resistance non-yellowing aliphatic TPU

TPU is a block copolymer consisting of alternating sequences of hard and soft segments or domains formed by the reaction of (1) diisocyanates with short-chain diols (chain extenders) and (2) diisocyanates with long-chain diols.
